response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, including some Java and JVM-related work, but lacks focused, recent, or deep expertise in enterprise Java/Kotlin tooling, Spring, or IDE internals — his recent work is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with minimal evidence of JVM ecosystem contributions.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong open-source contributions and tooling initiative (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Proven ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and complex systems
concerns: No recent or demonstrable work on Java/Kotlin IDE tooling or JVM internals
Primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, with Java appearing only in early roles
Lack of evidence of Spring, Hibernate, or enterprise build tool integration experience
